purpose: Keep every arXiv-style Human Infra paper page bound to explicit strong claims, core Claim IDs, falsifiers, downgrade actions and prohibited-use boundaries.
globalRequiredBoundaryPhrases: 不证明具体技术已经实现有效永生

requiredBoundaryPhrases: 不证明具体技术已经实现有效永生

strongClaims.claimText: Human Infra can translate singularity-style technology narratives into life-path modeling objects: variables, mechanisms, evidence boundaries, scenarios and visualization contracts.

falsifiers.condition: The page cannot identify variables, state transitions, risk functions or scenario outputs behind a technology narrative.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Downgrade the claim to a learning note and remove model-language framing.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: A variable map, model contract or source-card row connecting the narrative to HI-CL4.

falsifiers.condition: The cited source only supports a speculative forecast and not a methodological modeling step.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Keep the source as context only and mark the modeling claim as unsupported.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Claim-evidence row separating fact, trend, forecast and model use.

prohibitedUses: 不证明具体技术已经实现有效永生

strongClaims.claimText: LEV threshold visualization may express finite, critical and open-boundary states, but it must not become an individual lifespan prediction.

falsifiers.condition: A chart, table or script emits an individual death date, personal remaining-life estimate or personal medical recommendation.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Block the page and fail the model/paper boundary gate.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Audit output proving aggregate-only or synthetic-only reporting.

falsifiers.condition: LEV(t) > 1 is presented as guaranteed immortality rather than a scenario-state label.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Rewrite as an open-boundary expression and remove guarantee language.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Boundary paragraph and model card prohibited-use row.

prohibitedUses: 不证明具体技术已经实现有效永生

requiredBoundaryPhrases: 不证明具体技术已经实现有效永生

strongClaims.claimText: Effective immortality is framed as a conditional acceleration flywheel linking sustained time, learning rounds, accumulated capability, technology adoption, action quality and possibility space.

falsifiers.condition: Longer survival fails to translate into effective time, learning rounds, capability accumulation or option value.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Downgrade from acceleration flywheel to simple longevity extension.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Variable table showing T, E, R, C, A, Q and O links with evidence status.

falsifiers.condition: Technology adoption increases risk, dependency or cognitive load more than it improves action quality.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Mark the corresponding technology family as negative or cannot-evaluate.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Task-level evidence register with negative-channel rows.

prohibitedUses: 不证明具体技术已经实现有效永生

strongClaims.claimText: AI, memory tools, social systems and resources can enter the flywheel only through bounded task evidence, not through generic enhancement slogans.

falsifiers.condition: A technology claim lacks task, population, comparator, endpoint, uncertainty, cost or adverse-channel fields.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Remove it from the flywheel claim and keep it as a candidate technology.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: AI Task Evidence Register or equivalent source-card row.

falsifiers.condition: An effect is only a short-term productivity gain and cannot be linked to sustained subject-continuity capacity.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Limit the claim to local task support and remove long-term continuity implication.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Mechanism row connecting the task effect to capability, recovery or future option value.

prohibitedUses: 不证明具体技术已经实现有效永生

requiredBoundaryPhrases: 不证明具体技术已经实现有效永生

strongClaims.claimText: Metric-redshift recursive waiting is a conditional protocol: K is a proper-time differential input, not a direct benefit, safety proof or feasibility claim.

falsifiers.condition: A scenario lacks a defined metric, reference observer, subject worldline or K calculation boundary.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Classify the scenario as cannot-evaluate and block NCG calculation.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Metric Card and Orbit/Worldline Card.

falsifiers.condition: High K is used to override exit failure, continuity failure or tail-risk abort gates.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Classify the scenario as blocked or negative-under-current-evidence.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Abort-gate table showing PExit, PContinuity and RTail thresholds.

prohibitedUses: 不证明具体技术已经实现有效永生

strongClaims.claimText: Recursive waiting requires a Wait-Exit-Upgrade-Repeat state transition in which the upgrade improves the next waiting round's safety, access, repair or governance parameters.

falsifiers.condition: Exit, adoption or subject-continuity gates are unknown, zero or ungoverned.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Stop at protocol-only status and do not claim a recursive flywheel.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Scenario Cards covering Exit, Adoption, Continuity and Risk.

falsifiers.condition: The next state does not improve any waiting condition or increases catastrophic risk.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Classify the recursive step as failed and remove positive recursive language.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Upgrade-to-next-round parameter comparison.

prohibitedUses: 不证明具体技术已经实现有效永生

requiredBoundaryPhrases: 不证明具体技术已经实现有效永生

strongClaims.claimText: The public phrase 'black-hole waiting room' is narrowed into the formal research object 'metric-redshift proper-time differential waiting path'.

falsifiers.condition: The page discusses black holes without metric, proper-time, external-reference and exit/adoption definitions.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Keep the phrase as a public metaphor only and remove formal-path status.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Terminology table and physics-interface section.

falsifiers.condition: The phrase is used to imply resurrection, guaranteed immortality or practical engineering availability.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Block publication until non-goal and prohibited-use boundaries are restored.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Non-goal paragraph and prohibited-use language.

prohibitedUses: 不证明具体技术已经实现有效永生

strongClaims.claimText: Scenario cards and qualitative NCG scale must precede any claim that a future-waiting path has positive subject-continuity value.

falsifiers.condition: A scenario lacks metric, orbit/worldline, continuity, window, risk or exit cards.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Classify as cannot-evaluate and remove positive NCG language.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Six-card scenario packet.

falsifiers.condition: The NCG scale is used as a real quantitative prediction without calibrated variables.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Rewrite as qualitative screening only and block numerical prediction claims.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Model boundary row distinguishing qualitative scale, toy model and calibrated model.

prohibitedUses: 不证明具体技术已经实现有效永生

requiredBoundaryPhrases: 不证明具体技术已经实现有效永生

strongClaims.claimText: A controllable metric waiting room is only a hypothesis if metric control, proper-time differential, exit access, subject continuity, technical adoption and governance can be specified together.

falsifiers.condition: The proposed waiting room lacks controllable metric definition, access lifecycle or subject-continuity accounting.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Downgrade to speculative metaphor and remove research-object status.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Concept rows, state machine rows and continuity card.

falsifiers.condition: The scenario cannot compare against ordinary waiting, biostasis, relativistic travel or medical acceleration routes.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Mark as incomplete route card and block net-value claims.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Comparator row and opportunity-cost field.

prohibitedUses: 不证明具体技术已经实现有效永生

strongClaims.claimText: Toy NCG for controllable waiting rooms is a conceptual screening expression; high K cannot substitute for P_exit, P_adopt, P_cont, residual risk and opportunity-cost review.

falsifiers.condition: The page or data treats NCG as a calibrated predictor of individual lifespan, safety or engineering feasibility.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Block the claim and relabel NCG as non-predictive toy screening.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Pre-submission review row and prohibited-use statement.

falsifiers.condition: Probability gates are left at implicit 1 or risk terms are omitted.
falsifiers.downgradeAction: Classify the scenario as cannot-evaluate or negative depending on missingness and risk state.
falsifiers.evidenceNeeded: Gate column rows and risk matrix rows.

prohibitedUses: 不证明具体技术已经实现有效永生

nonClaims: This register does not prove any paper claim true.
This register does not validate external physics, biomedical, AI, engineering or governance literature.
This register only gates local arXiv-style paper pages so strong claims have traceable core Claim IDs, falsifiers, downgrade actions and prohibited-use boundaries.
